metadata.description: General-purpose Claude Code skills — versioned, validated, installable. Domain-agnostic authoring aids that aren't tied to any one plugin's job, distributed as cohesive skill-bundle plugins.

plugins.name: ui-decomposers
plugins.description: Two crossing-axis 'decomposer' skills for visual artifacts: ui-layout-decomposer (read, grade, and design any UI on the OUTSIDE-IN x INSIDE-OUT axes, with a four-archetype ASCII-wireframe library) and ui-mermaid-decomposer (create, decompose, and grade advanced Mermaid diagrams on the INTENT x RENDER axes, with a verbatim 11-type syntax catalog, a gated M1-M6 rubric, and a mechanized render-check).
